arguments.query: SELECT o.order_id,o.order_ts,o.status,i.quantity,i.unit_price_cents,p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LIMIT 8
SELECT region_code,count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY 1

SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0 AS amt, count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n, sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)/100.0/count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025'
SELECT count(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.region_code='TW-N' AND o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025'
